text:
oliver: Planning a short maintenance in az3 tonight 23:30-00:50 UTC on preemptible GPU cohort. We'll apply NIC microcode + kernel backports. Doing node-by-node to avoid big drops.
aj: How many nodes and expected GPU capacity hit?
oliver: 7 nodes. Expect transient 6-10% available-GPU decrease during the window, should settle to <2% after warmbackfill. Each node ~10-14m.
maria: Suggest warmbackfill in eu-west as cross-region hedge for critical low-latency tenants if needed. That costs extra egress but keeps p95 stable.
lia: Steps: 1) 30m preheat KV/cache on warmback nodes; 2) scale dedicated pool +1 replica 20m prior; 3) pause noninteractive cronjobs; 4) run preflight. I'll prepare k8s snippets.
aj: What about routing? fallback rules?
maria: Router: primary interruptible, fallback dedicated in-region, cross-region eu-west only if in-region fallback breaches latency threshold. Config sample: `fallback_policy: [in-region-dedicated, eu-west-dedicated]; latency_threshold_ms:350`.
lia: I'll add a temporary autoscaler override: `kubectl annotate deployment/dedicated-pool infra/override=maintenance --overwrite` then scale. Remember to remove annotation after.
oncall-eu: I'm on call for EU, can be standing by if we need cross-region shift.
sre-bot: Reminder: run `infra preflight --region az3` 30m prior and upload snapshot. Automated status page post will happen at start.
aj: Abort conditions?
oliver: Abort if p95 > 500ms for 3m, error-rate >1% for 5m, or unexpected pod-evictions > baseline. Playbook has exact numbers.
maria: Cost estimate: cross-region hedge ~2.5 GPU-hours if used, roughly $90. In-region backfill ~1.0 GPU-hour ~$35. Logged to infra-maint.
lia: I'll also throttle embeddings batch to avoid backlog: patch cronjob with `concurrencyPolicy=Forbid` 10m prior, revert 30m after.
aj: Can we seed prefix cache after each node reboot? that helped last time.
oliver: Yes — run `kv_seed.py --prefix /model-ks --region az3` after smoke test on each node. Wait 5m between seed and next drain.
lia: Added 60s guard between drain steps to let autoscaler react.
mar ia: (typo) maria: will monitor dashboards and post 30m preflight. :white_check_mark:
